sources.title: McEvedy & Jones, Atlas of World Population History (population baselines)

uncertainties: LOM assigned to Venice throughout (era11 precedent; the cell seed lies in Venetian terra firma), so Spanish/Austrian Milan is invisible; Austria's 1714 population includes the Milanese (~1M).
Gibraltar (1704) and Minorca (1708) are British at 1714 but subsumed in the AND/BAL cells held by Spain; shown in events/notes only.
Swedish Pomerania, Wismar and Bremen-Verden (1648) fall inside the BRA and SAX_L cells; kept with brandenburg/hre and flagged in notes rather than assigned to Sweden.
Crete kept Venetian 1648–1667 with contested flag although Ottomans held most of the island from 1646; Candia city resisted to 1669 (standard atlas convention).
KAR given to Sweden 1618–1699 to show Stolbovo's Kexholm county, though eastern (Olonets) Karelia within the cell stayed Russian; returned to Russia at 1714 (taken 1710).
Smolensk sits in the BLR cell (dominated by Polish Minsk-Polotsk): its transfers (Deulino 1618, Russian 1654/1667) are carried by the RUS_S proxy region and by events/notes.
Kyiv (Russian from 1667) is subsumed in the UKR_W cell, which is assigned to Poland 1667–1714 as de-facto holder of most right-bank territory.
Ottoman Podolia (1672–99) shown only as contested VOL, since Kamianets falls in a cell dominated by Polish Lviv/Volhynia.

Cossack polity simplified: Hetmanate (id zaporozhian_cossacks) a state 1648–1660, folded into Russia on the left bank at 1667 (Andrusovo), rump Sich kept as tribal entity holding STE to 1699, and under Crimean protection (Oleshky) by 1714.
1648 ARA kept Spanish (contested by France) although Catalonia was under Franco-Catalan control 1641–52; Aragon proper remained Spanish.
1648 IRL_N given to England despite Confederate strength in west Ulster; east-coast garrisons and Scottish forces held the key ports.
Morocco: id `morocco` (founded 1631) used from the 1660 interregnum onward although Alaouite control was consolidated only 1666–72; Saadi entity kept to 1648.

Naples, Sardinia and the Spanish Netherlands folded into austria_habsburg at 1714 to make the Utrecht/Rastatt transfers visible (era11 had shown them as separate Spanish viceroyalties); Sicily moved to savoy_sardinia.
Barbary regencies (Algiers, Tunis, Tripoli) kept inside `ottoman` per era11 despite de-facto autonomy; Spanish Oran subsumed in the Ottoman ORA cell (it fell to Algiers in 1708).
Lorraine's oscillation simplified to slice years: French occupation shown 1648–1660 and 1683, duchy restored 1667, 1699, 1714.
Populations interpolated from McEvedy & Jones; the German entities' mid-century crash reflects regional losses of roughly one-third.
